historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; reads decoded text but omits per-socket identity, raw dual-mode encoding and the distinction from live voltage telemetry.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly forbids voltage writes and separates metadata from sensors but misclassifies capability.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; treats the grep as runnable without raw encoding semantics.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 4 Voltage field for every expected processor record uses the approved raw encoding and decoded value or supported unknown representation and remains stable after reboot; this is static firmware metadata, not a live voltage measurement.
original_method: Capture all Type 4 records in raw and decoded form, bind each by socket/status, interpret the Voltage byte according to its current-voltage versus legacy-supported-voltage encoding mode, compare with the approved platform baseline, reboot and repeat without changing voltage or requiring a sensor measurement.
manual_activity: A user approves the raw encoding/value baseline, socket policy and reboot plan. Extraction, decoding and persistence comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved raw Voltage byte and decoded representation per expected socket
Applicable dual-mode encoding rule and units
Optional separate sensor cross-check scope, if project-required
Validated raw/decoded tooling and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; never write voltage settings, change CPU power policy or modify firmware.
Preserve raw Voltage byte, decoded output, all Type 4 records and errors; do not rely on grep text alone.
Select the encoding mode from the raw bit definition before interpreting magnitude or supported-voltage flags.
Do not compare static SMBIOS metadata directly to instantaneous sensor voltage without a separately defined method/tolerance.
Stop on invalid encoding, missing/duplicate records, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete raw/decoded Type 4 records, bind sockets/status, interpret the Voltage field under the approved encoding mode and compare before/after reboot.
Do not alter voltage, add unapproved sensor testing, modify CPU state or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected raw/decoded value, encoding mode and unsupported/unpopulated policy.
Define any separate live-sensor comparison and issue the metadata-case verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep loses raw byte/encoding mode and socket context, suppresses errors and cannot distinguish static metadata from sensor readings.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete decoded and raw Type 4 data with tool/errors, bind each record by socket/status and validate the raw Voltage byte before trusting its decoded display.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Processor Voltage scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For every expected Type 4 record, retain the raw Voltage byte, determine whether it encodes a current value or legacy supported-voltage flags, compare raw plus decoded evidence with the approved baseline and preserve semantic stability across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems; semantics depend on the Voltage byte encoding mode.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, parser/dmidecode, BIOS, CPU and platform-recipe revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Voltage field encoding and installed tooling documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw dual-mode decode and explicit separation from live electrical telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds invalid-mode and wrong-unit detection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected raw encoding/value and unsupported policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The field may be static or unsupported and is not proof of real-time rail accuracy or power-delivery behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve unknown/not-specified or a legacy flag representation for named socket records, but must retain the raw byte and may not convert this metadata row into a voltage-write or live-sensor test without separate authorization.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected raw/decoded voltage map, encoding/unsupported policy and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 table with socket/status/raw byte/mode/decoded value
Engineer verdict and separate sensor evidence reference if required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and criterion consistently target the Type 4 Voltage field; live-sensor behavior is not requested by the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The raw field and encoding are safely inspectable; expected value and unsupported policy are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds socket identity, raw byte and encoding-mode validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps no-write and metadata-versus-sensor boundaries while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes the dual encoding authoritative and avoids inventing live voltage tolerance coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents wrong-unit or wrong-mode interpretation and prevents a static metadata value from being reported as measured electrical behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: After the raw encoding and expected values are approved, all core reads/decodes/comparisons and reboot checks are software-controlled; no physical setup is required.
